notes: is_addon=true rows are burger/chicken 'style' or topping add-ons listed under a base item's category; some source rows appear to duplicate the base item's macros verbatim (e.g. Club Style, Original Style) or show implausible values (e.g. Cajun Style Add with 0g fat) - these reflect apparent inconsistencies/typos in the original Cook Out PDF and were transcribed as-is rather than corrected.

A few serving-size strings in the source PDF have internal unit inconsistencies (e.g. Bacon Ranch Wrap listed as '2.62 oz (41 g)', Club Style Add listed with a stray 'oz' instead of 'g') - transcribed as printed.
Powerade Mountain Blast rows show sodium_mg equal to calories, which looks like a copy error in the source; transcribed as printed.
Carbohydrate values for Fancy Milkshakes and fountain beverages are frequently less than (carbs - fiber - sugar) would suggest exactly; minor rounding in the source is preserved as printed.
